def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # normalize sex labels (trailing/extra spaces, case)
    d['sex'] = d['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    d.loc[~d['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    # body_mass_g written as text with thousands separators -> numeric
    d['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        d['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce')
    # enforce allowed range for body mass
    d.loc[(d['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (d['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
